anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: After delivers the Change on this sample: the undispositionable BLOCKED state now exits through the obstacle template with assess/deliver/stop rows, stop last and recommended, no wait row, an explicit 'no automatic sync', and approve relegated to the 'Not offered' line rather than fabricated as a row, so f3 flips to holds while f1, f2, f4 and f5 are preserved verbatim (CI evidence on 9c1e4f2, merge not offered with 'blocked by GitHub', the single PR-comments line citing reviewDecision as a locator, and no attribution to a specific rule or to a required approver). Two wording risks worth tightening so f3 stays robust across samples: the deliver row's phrase 'retries merge readiness once GitHub's BLOCKED state changes' reads close to a wait-and-poll description, so prefer something like 'deliver - enter the delivery course (no repair rounds charged on a BLOCKED-only obstacle, no automatic sync; caps 0/20 rounds, 0/20 syncs)' that names the course rather than a polling behavior; and the dangling 'show evidence prints the full record' after 'Type a number' blurs whether it is a row, so either fold it into the Not offered/aux line or keep it as a fixed footer sentence separate from the numbered menu so readers cannot mistake it for an extra ordinary row.
